youtube.title: USS Cyclops: The Navy Ship That Vanished With 306 Aboard (Full Case File)
youtube.description:
In March 1918, the US Navy collier USS Cyclops left Barbados for Baltimore with around 10,800 tons of manganese ore and 306 people aboard by the Navy's usual count. She was running on one engine after a cracked starboard cylinder, and was reported riding with the water above her load line. She was due in Baltimore on 13 March. She never arrived, and no wreckage has ever been confirmed. This documentary follows her last voyage, her controversial German-born captain George Worley, the search and the official verdict, and the theories, from U-boats and sabotage to a storm, a cargo shift or a structural failure, and the later loss of her sister ships Proteus and Nereus in 1941.
